_comment: Extra paper accounts (docs/extra-accounts.md). Optional: without /etc/paperbot/extras.json the live runner uses these defaults. Copy to /etc/paperbot/extras.json only to change something; the runner re-reads it at each live 5-minute boundary (no restart needed, except for accept_code). Keys starting with _ are ignored.
_agents_db: agents3.db (read-only). Default: next to paper3.db. Setting only one of agents_db / inbox_db turns new-account activation off (with a warning); running extras keep running.
_inbox_db: inbox.db (read-only): the owners' approve / reject clicks. Default: next to paper3.db.
_observe_days: No account is created (and no proposal counts) before run start + this many days. Never lower than 21 (the file cannot lower it); above 3650 it is read as 3650.
_observe_until: Optional KST date (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive) that extends the observation period.
_owner_ok_days: Copy proposals decided before run start + this many days need the owners' click. Never lower than 60. New-strategy accounts always need it.
_budget_s: Wall-time budget (seconds) of the new-strategy signal computation at a live boundary; jobs past it are skipped and reported.
_pause_activation: true: create no new account (set it before restoring agents3.db or inbox.db, back to false after).
_agents_ack: After an agents3.db restore the runner refuses activation until this holds the fingerprint string shown in the CRITICAL alert / the dashboard / 'python -m paperbot.extras status'.
_inbox_ack: After an inbox.db restore (or an empty inbox.db in its place) the runner refuses activation until this holds the string shown in the CRITICAL alert / 'python -m paperbot.extras status' (approval:<id>@<ts>). First ask the owners to click again every approve / reject made after the backup.
_accept_code: Account id -> the new code pin shown in the alert, when the owners accept changed signal code for a suspended new-strategy account (a Q5 event for that account). Applied at the next restart.
